name: Kayık
scene: A rowing boat with a broad oar rests on a calm lake.
notes: Medium design; target 28–45 panes. Second generation retained after first exceeded pane count and used amber in sky. Final raster has 45 coloured connected components above 500 pixels; visually checked closed lead lines, junctions, silhouette, colour pairs and pane count. Boat and oar use amber/rust; background uses blue/turquoise. Remaining doubts: subtle generated shading persists rather than perfectly flat fills; some neighbouring panes share a colour (including oar blade halves, interior planks and sky), so tracing may merge these; tight junctions around boat rim and benches need geometry-stage review. Opaque white exterior, 1086×1448. Style reference: vitray_lighthouse.png. Design sheet only.
